steps.say: every morning, one voice wakes first: the inner voice. it's often loud because it's trying to help.
it learned its ways long ago, to keep people safe. it has worked hard. that makes sense, and it deserves a thank you.
i'm {companion}. i don't replace that voice. i keep watch while a second one grows: a voice that's truly yours, in your own words.
everything kind that gets kept becomes a star in the book. that's the whole world here: a sky, and the stars someone adds. let's walk it.
this is home. the sky follows the hour, so it looks different at dawn and at night.
one next step waits here, so there's never a pile to sort through.
two shortcuts: something kind, and a way to turn a loud thought down. both are always here.
learn is short chats with me, one small idea at a time. tap it whenever you're curious.
each path is a theme: kindness, the inner voice, voice habits, what someone likes and thinks. open any, in any order.
these little bars fill in as lessons are read. no scores, just a way to see where someone left off.
practice is for the moment itself, when the voice gets loud and a minute is all there is.
catch it takes three taps to note a habit. answer it finds new words to say back. breathe is one slow minute.
ways to answer show an example, where it comes from, and how strong the evidence is. try one on, keep what fits.
the book is the sky from the story, made real. it's private, and it grows a star for each thing kept.
pages sort what's kept: words, about me, keepers. only kind things go in. nothing harsh is ever offered to keep.
the shelf shows lessons read, as books. nothing here to catch up on.
the you tab is the quiet back room: the voice map, where habits show up, how loud it's been. for noticing, never judging.
settings holds read aloud, soft sounds, and real help at the bottom. thanks for looking around. replay this there any time.
